name: sim
about: Clicker Kingdom — a Roblox pet / clicker simulator: candy-bright, chunky white-and-navy bubbles with thick outlines, gloss on top, bouncy motion, huge numbers, illustrated icons with outlines; everything reads from across the room on a phone
world: a sunny toy world; the UI is a sticker sheet of glossy bubbles over it
bans: thin hairline frames and flourishes (that is the souls identity)
serif or grotesque faces (Fredoka One / Luckiest Guy only)
dark text on dark, white text without an outline over the world
a slow fade — this world pops and bounces
one outline weight for everything: panels 5, buttons 5, chips 4, cards 6

references.take: currencies top-left as white pills with the icon overlapping the left end, a huge rounded number and a green plus; a vertical stack of big square bubble buttons on the left (Shop, Pets, Eggs, Rebirth, Codes...) each with an illustrated icon and a label under it; the equipped pets as a row of card slots along the bottom; a progress pill top-centre for the current goal; every bubble has a thick navy outline, a white top gloss and a short drop shadow; all text white with a dark outline over the world
references.source: the game as played (2024-2026 builds); community notes: most UI is image-based ImageButtons with custom graphics (DevForum 'Unique or good looking ui', 2914121)

references.game: Pet Simulator X / Bee Swarm Simulator / Adopt Me
references.take: one big rounded panel with a chunky title banner overlapping its top edge, a red circular close button on the corner, tabs as pills, a scrolling grid of item cards with a rarity-coloured frame and header, the price as a pill with the currency icon, the primary action a green bubble; the selected card gets a thicker glow
references.source: the games as played; DevForum critique on a Pet-Sim-X-style UI (2297137): 'try making the outlines thinner', 'the title text larger', 'buttons on the left all larger', the backdrop should move; 'extremely unoriginal' is the failure mode

references.take: the egg on a burst of rays with 'Hatch 1 / Hatch 3' bubbles priced in gems and a chance list by rarity; rebirth as a dramatic confirm card with the multiplier gain huge; daily rewards as a 7-day grid with today pulsing and claimed days greyed with a check

lettering.evidence: the sim identity's own rules (bans: 'white text without an outline over the world', outline weights 5 at 48 px = 0.1 em, chunky drop shadow 6): the typed Luckiest Guy titles became lettered art (hero_typed_glyph gate, 2026-10-16)
